deathSays.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Evelyn Grabowski. Plumber. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Photo album, Dead Phone, Search locket, Carpenter's square, Trail compass. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. The stars are wrong. They move when you aren't looking. Yesterday there were seven. Tonight there are nine. They're getting closer.
